## 3dslibris 3.2.1

This update fixes folder covers not showing when the image is placed inside the folder.

### Fixes and improvements

- [#185](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/185): library folders now show a cover when the image is inside the folder with the folder's name (`book/Foo/Foo.jpg`), in addition to next to it (`book/Foo.jpg`). If both exist, the one next to the folder is used. Supported types are `jpg`, `jpeg` and `png`.
- Added this information to the README.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone trying the builds and reporting issues. You can support the project with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
